Body cavities

ORIENTATION FIRST

Two major compartments.

The dorsal cavity protects the brain and spinal cord. The ventral cavity includes the thoracic and abdominopelvic cavities.

Make it stick

Dorsal is behind. Ventral holds the viscera.
